scope: Job Matching Engine coordinating transparent score formatting ('91/100 — Excellent Match'), canonical match category classification, deterministic sorting, honest UNKNOWN semantics, and JobMatchScoreBadge UI component.

acceptance.transparent_scoring: PASS; every job receives a transparent score formatted canonically as '91/100 — Excellent Match' (and tuned for all bands).
acceptance.canonical_categories: PASS; six canonical categories (EXCEPTIONAL 95-100, EXCELLENT 85-94, STRONG 75-84, POSSIBLE 60-74, WEAK 40-59, POOR 0-39) plus INCOMPLETE are deterministically classified.
acceptance.batch_deterministic_sorting: PASS; batch_score_job_matches provides zero-jitter deterministic ordering by score descending and job_id ascending.
acceptance.frontend_components: PASS; JobMatchScoreBadge renders transparent scores in both compact tag mode and full disclosure card mode with icons, dealbreaker alerts, and signal coverage.
acceptance.safety: PASS; external submission OFF asserted; no external API calls, unauthorized network requests, or background daemons.

checks.target: Unit tests for score formatting, category classification, single-job scoring, and batch sorting
Integration tests with database jobs, dealbreakers, and batch ranking
TypeScript check and Vite production client build
